title: SpaceX Just Out-Launched The Entire World
source: SpaceX annual launch counts from company/industry launch trackers (SpaceNews, NASASpaceFlight.com). 'Rest of world' is total global orbital launch attempts for the year (widely reported annual tallies, e.g. SpaceNews/Payload/Wikipedia 'in spaceflight' roundups) minus SpaceX's own launches. Approximate for years without one single authoritative public tally; 2023-2024 totals are the most precisely reported. SpaceX alone out-launched the rest of the world combined in 2024 (134 vs. roughly 127).
